metadata.description: A personal Claude Code harness: guard hooks, a git workflow, verifiable code maps and a mentor mode, installable into any project.

plugins.name: harness-core
plugins.description: Guard hooks (protected branches, attribution trailers, destructive rm), a missing-tool check, a configurable post-edit check, a cheap scout agent, and /harness-init to set a project up.

plugins.name: git-workflow
plugins.description: Issue-first branching, Conventional Commits, opening and reviewing pull/merge requests on GitHub or GitLab.

plugins.name: code-maps
plugins.description: Investigate code or docs once and keep a digest whose staleness is checked by git blob hashes, not guessed.

plugins.name: mentor
plugins.description: Answers technical questions the way a senior engineer mentors a junior: one layer below the abstraction, with the transferable principle named.

plugins.name: tone
plugins.description: A terse, military-register output style: answer first, numbered steps for tasks, a one-line insight only when it teaches something non-obvious.
